item.title: Railway Blocked by Google Cloud
item.description:
📝 Google Cloud has blocked our account, making some Railway services unavailable. We have escalated this directly with Google. The Railway Platform team has since confirmed access to Google Cloud and is working on restoring access to all workloads.

item.title: Gemini CLI will stop working from June 18, 2026
item.description:
📝 For enterprise customersIf your organization uses Gemini CLI or our IDE extensions via a Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise license, or if your organization uses Gemini Code Assist for GitHub through Google Cloud, your access remains unchanged. We’ll continue to support Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist with access to the latest Gemini models and other updates. Gemini CLI will remain accessible via paid Gemini and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform API keys.
🔗 Read more: https://developers.googleblog.com/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/
